description: COCONURTURE is an organic potting filler formulated by blending crushed tender coconut husks, coir pith compost, farmyard manure, Trichoderma, and soil in precise proportions. The formulation was developed based on field trials conducted by the National Coir Research and Management Institute (NCRMI).
applications: • Manufacturing of commercial organic potting mixes • Production of bio-enriched nursery growing media • Deployment in commercial greenhouse and horticulture cultivation • Formulation of soil-less agricultural substrates • Processing of coir industry by-products into agricultural inputs
